AFTER.text: AFTER(G)>NAME := nthN(order, add(add(1, 1), 1))    [reproduces 6/78 shown examples; under the fit floor: answers NOTHING]

BEFORE.text: BEFORE(G)>NAME := nthN(order, add(1, 1))    [reproduces 6/78 shown examples; under the fit floor: answers NOTHING]

BETWEEN.text:
BETWEEN(G,G)>NAME := @BEFORE(G)>NAME(x0)    [reproduces 6/72 shown examples; under the fit floor: answers NOTHING]
  where @BEFORE(G)>NAME := nthN(order, add(1, 1))

CHAIN.text:
AFTER then OTHER_CASE := compose of the parts' programs, in order (a NAME passed on to a glyph slot is the name's first TEACH exemplar)
  AFTER(G)>NAME := nthN(order, add(add(1, 1), 1))
  OTHER_CASE(G;cands)>PICK := compose(&NAME(G)>NAME, &POINT(N;cands)>PICK)
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where @POINT(N;cands)>PICK := argmaxG(cands, λa. maxofG(taught(x0), λb. sim(b, a)))
  where @NAME(G)>NAME := f0(x0)

LOOP.text:
LOOP(G)>YESNO := f2(x0)    [reproduces 192/228 shown examples; answers]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where f1(#0:G, #1:N) -> B := eq(f0(#0), #1)
  where f2(#0:G) -> B := f1(#0, nthN(order, 0))

MIRROR.text:
MIRROR(G)>YESNO := compose(&BEFORE(G)>NAME, &LOOP(G)>YESNO)    [reproduces 162/216 shown examples; under the fit floor: answers NOTHING]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where f1(#0:G, #1:N) -> B := eq(f0(#0), #1)
  where f2(#0:G) -> B := f1(#0, nthN(order, 0))
  where @LOOP(G)>YESNO := f2(x0)
  where @BEFORE(G)>NAME := nthN(order, add(1, 1))

OTHER_CASE.text:
OTHER_CASE(G;cands)>PICK := compose(&NAME(G)>NAME, &POINT(N;cands)>PICK)    [reproduces 35/36 shown examples; answers]
  where f0(#0:G) -> N := argmaxN(order, λa. maxofG(taught(a), λb. sim(#0, b)))
  where @POINT(N;cands)>PICK := argmaxG(cands, λa. maxofG(taught(x0), λb. sim(b, a)))
  where @NAME(G)>NAME := f0(x0)

TWO_AFTER.text:
